title: Security gate criteria & acceptance matrix for SSO/RBAC/audit/KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Define a single, implementation-agnostic acceptance matrix and sign-off checklist for Private and Dedicated customers requiring SSO (SAML/OIDC), fine-grained RBAC, immutable audit logs, and KMS/HSM integration. This PRD clarifies requirements, enumerates scope boundaries, highlights trade-offs, and lists final acceptance gates for QA, Security, and Sales enablement.

Background: Several enterprise prospects and pilot customers have stalled on procurement due to uncertainty about Private deployment security controls. Engineering has prototypes for SAML SSO and a pluggable KMS shim; however, product-level decisions are needed on RBAC granularity, audit retention SLAs, and the minimum supported KMS HSM modes.

This ticket captures the product-level acceptance criteria we will require for GA of the security / compliance bundle in private and dedicated offerings.
requirements: SSO: Support SAML 2.0 IdP integrations plus OIDC provider flow; metadata import and test-connect UI; account-linking and SCIM provisioning optional but described.
RBAC: Role model with at least Admin/Operator/Developer/Audit roles; resource scoping at org, project, and model endpoints; allow custom roles via role templates (managed by admin UI + API).

Audit logs: Immutable append-only logs for authentication, admin actions (role changes, key rotations), model deploys, and request-level metadata; retention configurable with export to customer Kinesis/S3/ELK.
KMS/HSM: Pluggable key provider with support for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault and PKCS#11 HSM endpoints; support for key rotation, envelope encryption, and customer-managed keys (BYOK).
Operational: Admin audit UI with filterable events, exportable CSV/JSON, and alerts for suspicious auth activity; default retention 90 days with 365/730 options for enterprise tiers.
Compliance: Provide documentation and DPIA notes for data flow; support for SOC2-type controls checklist and optional HIPAA addendum for private deployments.
scope: GA scope includes SAML 2.0 + OIDC SSO, core RBAC roles and API, audit logging with export hooks, and KMS integrations for envelope encryption. Out of scope for GA: full SCIM provisioning, custom RBAC DSL, and automated compliance attestations (these are follow-ups).
scope_changes: 2025-02-07: Reduced RBAC initial scope from flexible policy language to fixed role templates (Admin/Operator/Developer/Audit) to meet GA timelines.
2025-02-10: Deferred SCIM provisioning to follow-up epic PM-4920 after customer pilot learnings.
2025-02-11: Narrowed KMS support plan to AWS/GCP/Azure + PKCS#11; removed planned Vault auto-unseal integration for GA.
acceptance_criteria: SSO: Admin can add a SAML IdP by uploading metadata or entering metadata URL and complete a successful test-auth within staging with a sample IdP (documented steps).
SSO: OIDC provider flow can be configured and tested using a public OIDC provider; token exchange and user mapping documented in API docs.
RBAC: Admin UI shows the four roles and allows assigning roles to users; API exposes role assignment and respects enforcement for model deploy, billing view, and console settings.
RBAC: Enforcement verified by integration tests and a demo script where a Developer cannot perform key rotation or change org-wide settings.

Audit logs: Every auth event, role change, key rotation, and model deployment writes a log event with timestamp, actor, resource, and request_id; logs are immutable in the system and can be exported to S3 in newline-delimited JSON.
KMS: Customer can configure a KMS endpoint and perform a key rotation from the console/API; secrets are never persisted unencrypted and envelope encryption verified by unit/integration tests.
Compliance docs: Security and data flow diagrams, DPIA summary, and SOC2 checklist are authored and attached to the customer-facing security pack in Confluence.
Performance: Enabling audit export and KMS BYOK does not increase median 99th percentile request latency by more than 5% in dedicated staging under representative load test.
signoff_checklist: Product: Acceptance criteria verified in staging and test-runbook created (owner: PM).
Security: Threat model and design review completed, outstanding findings tracked (owner: Security Eng).
Engineering: Integration tests + e2e security test suite green in CI and staging (owner: Lead Engineer).
Legal/Compliance: DPIA and data flow doc reviewed; contract language for BYOK and audit exports approved (owner: Legal).
Support & Sales: Customer-facing security pack and runbook published; Sales enablement session completed (owner: Solutions Eng).
Documentation: Admin console flows, API docs, and migration notes published (owner: Docs).
Release: Feature flags and rollout plan created; canary plan and automatic rollback defined (owner: Release Manager).
notes: 2025-02-06: Quick sync with Security Ops — agreed default retention 90 days for GA (Aisha, Mateo).
2025-02-08: Engineering flagged a dependency on runtime key rotation APIs (ENG-2378) — added to dependencies.
2025-02-11: Sales requested explicit SLA language for audit export delivery; Legal to draft addendum.
